text: : Ipradol†. Ibudilast (rINN) AV-411; Ibudilastum; KC-404; MN-166. 1-(2-Isopropylpyrazo- lo[1,5-a]pyridin-3-yl)-2-methyl-1-propanone. Ибудиласт C14H18N2O = 230.3. CAS — 50847-11-5. ATC — R03DC04. ATC Vet — QR03DC04. Profile Ibudilast is an orally active leukotriene antagonist (p.1108), phosphodiesterase inhibitor, and platelet-activating factor antag- onist. It is given orally in the management of asthma (p.1108) in a dose of 10 mg twice daily. Ibudilast is also promoted for the management of dizziness sec- ondary to impaired cerebral circulation following cerebral inf- arction, in doses of 10 mg three times daily. Ibudilast is also under investigation for the treatment of multiple sclerosis and for chronic neuropathic pain. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Jpn: Ketas. CAS — 312753-06-3. Profile Indacaterol is a long-acting beta2 agonist under investigation in asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
